name: zclass_class_delete_node_by_type
description: zClass_Class::DeleteNodeByType validates ownership state and dispatches node deletion by class id.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers parent-count guard, base-node dispatch, unknown-class error return, and typed-delete dependency coverage. VC5SP3 target zclass_remove_child_delete_dispatch still fails this function with 111 unmasked mismatches after 86 relocation bytes; remaining drift is the saved-argument/register-allocation shape around the class-id dispatch.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x447980 validates null-node return 5, parent-count guard return 1, class-id jump table dispatch for object/world/animate/light/sound/base nodes, unknown-class error return 1, and class-0 return of the original node pointer value after TryFreeNode.
The native smoke verifies direct DeleteNodeByType class-0 dispatch, parent-count refusal, unknown-class refusal, and the dependent world/animate delete paths.
